title: The market adjusts slowly
hook: Two stated cases: explore the adjustment speed in a stated price path.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the adjustment speed in a stated price path affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Estimate, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the adjustment speed in a stated price path in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
